name: Server Console
summary: A dashboard for your Automaton server: CPU, memory, disk, OS updates, restart status, versions, certificates and backups, with 24 hours of history and webhook warnings.
description: Shows how your Automaton server and its Runners are doing, read-only: CPU, memory, disk and load with 24 hours of history, Docker disk use, OS name and uptime, pending and security updates, restart required, server and Runner versions and whether a newer release exists, certificate expiry and the last backup. Sends one webhook warning when disk space runs low, security updates wait too long or a restart is overdue, and one message when it is resolved. It only asks for server:read, so it cannot change anything on the server.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py console.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py console.py index.html dashboard.js dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: API_BASE_URL
settings.description: Base URL of this Automaton server's API, for example https://api.example.com

settings.name: DISK_FREE_WARN_PERCENT
settings.description: Warn when less than this percent of the disk is free

settings.name: SECURITY_UPDATE_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when security updates have been waiting longer than this many days

settings.name: REBOOT_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when a restart has been required longer than this many days

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Where warnings are sent: a Slack, Discord or Telegram webhook URL, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST. Empty: warnings only appear in the log and on the page
